title: Schauberger's propulsion work taken to Brookhaven

tellings.quote: Shaburgger I know the army counter intelligence corp tricked into giving all of his propulsion exotic propulsion stuff uh to the US and that made it actually to Brook Haven National Labs Nick Cook.com

plain: An inventor named Viktor Schauberger was tricked by the US Army Counter Intelligence Corps, an Army intelligence unit, into handing over his work on exotic propulsion, and that work ended up at Brookhaven National Laboratory, a US government research lab. Michels tells this himself, pointing to a researcher named Nick Cook and his website as the source; if true, it would mean unusual propulsion ideas were quietly taken into American government science.
